structure: Part 4 mined all 9 traces its partition names, each opened and its full action list read, with snapshots and evals on every page in scope and the network log read for each: description-of-the-goods.fit.spec.js commodity details (cattle number of animals, 97 actions; two commodities horse and pig, 67 actions; germinal cattle semen, 91 actions), total gross weight (germinal, 98 actions; live animals have no gross weight page, 52 actions), additional details (cattle, 71 actions; poultry, 62 actions), and snagging.fit.spec.js S13 (selected commodities table, cattle, 52 actions) and S14 (spacing above each commodity title, horse and pig, with an error state, 66 actions). All 9 recorded 0 errors; validation shows as re-rendered pages. Every trace walks the opening run (create-notification, notification-type, origin-of-the-import, what-are-you-importing, reason-for-import with Internal market / Breeding) to reach its page; that run belongs to other parts and is not claimed here. Pages claimed, in journey order: /consignment-details (Commodity details: always, after the main import reason; one block per selected commodity, with Number of animals and, for some species, Number of packages for live animals, or Quantity (unit/pieces), Number of packages and one Temperature question for germinal products); /consignment-gross-weight (What is the total gross weight of the consignment?: germinal products only, after commodity details, before identification details; live animals are redirected away); /additional-animal-details (Additional details: live animals, after identification details, before arrival details; cattle get certification purpose and unweaned animals, poultry get certification purpose only). Identification details is reached in several traces but belongs to part 5; only the routes into and out of it are claimed here. Refs cite the trace zip by file name (all in workareas/shared/design-release-2-1/sources/traces-prototype/) and an action id from its actions list, or a request id from its requests list. Snapshot pointers: commodity details cattle action 45 (default), 58 (empty error), 73 (zero error) of the cattle number-of-animals zip; two commodities action 42 and 52; germinal action 36 (default), 49 (required errors), 64 (invalid errors); gross weight action 39 (default), 53, 66, 73 (errors), 85 (next page); additional details cattle action 49, poultry action 43; S13 action 38; S14 action 44 (default) and 52 (error). The prototype is a GOV.UK Prototype Kit app holding answers in its session; no call to any other system appears in any network log.
